notes: Every boot-1 target lay in a region absent from the disposable world. Those regions (r.5.7, r.7.5, r.3.9) then held small 12 KB files the server had written, and after exported copies replaced them every target moved. Maps also skip structures an earlier map already found, so the move is consistent with 'generated chunks without starts are skipped' but does not prove it on its own
No natural cobbleverse:brock start exists in the copied outside region, so the 'natural gym' case was not available

conclusion: No placement method tested (/place structure, /place jigsaw, /place template) wrote structures.starts or structures.References to any chunk. Every consumer that reads structure data (/locate, location_check, the Cobbleverse gym_map exploration map) ignored the hand-placed builds, while natural mega_site and mineshaft starts in the same world passed.
